correctness.rationale: The affine coordinate ring is free over k[x] on y-powers 0 through p-1, and its mu_{2(p-1)} invariants are explicitly free over k[x^{2(p-1)}] on 1 and x^{2(p-1)-2b}y^b. At the unique fully ramified infinity the pole orders are p and p+bL, with L invertible modulo p; pairwise incongruent residues prove no cancellation and completeness. The Apéry set determines all remaining invariants by exact finite sums. The included code checks six finite parameter choices with independent gap enumeration; it does not stand in for the infinite proof. The source quotient construction and standard one-place Artin–Schreier valuation theorem supply the geometric premises.

value.rationale: The complete marked-point Weierstrass semigroup is a natural geometric invariant for an unbounded-genus family of maximal curves with trivial geometric automorphisms, and it is not implied by previously given genus, automorphism or gonality results. Full Apéry and pseudo-Frobenius data, the point weight and explicit one-point Riemann–Roch dimensions can inform AG-code construction and ramification geometry. The result is a uniform structural classification, not an arbitrary finite cutoff or a mere numerical specialization.
